paper.title: Self-Evolving Visual Concept Library using Vision-Language Critics
paper.central_claim: VLM critic引导LLM结合历史迭代演化无需额外人工概念标注的可解释文本概念库，增强零样本/少样本/微调分类。
paper.scope: A类非权重概念库自演化；同时可训练CBM adapter，不将权重本身算harness改动。

provenance.notes: 派发sonnet→gpt-6.1-sol；无独立模型调用receipt/session信息，依模板null。无运行论文代码、外部检索或其他席/批次结果访问。领域卡只消费机制条件，未以成员结果/录用统计评分。

sections_read: Abstract、§1–6、Algorithm1、Eq1–3、Tables1–10、Figures1–7图注、附录§7.1–7.11、HTML末尾；图内未转写prompt不属数值依据

evidence.quote: This mutation process focuses on each class in isolation and must be repeated for each class, which proves to be impractical for datasets with more than 20 classes.
evidence.support_explanation: 作者与llm-mutate的差异是联合类间混淆和定向选择，非首次概念演化。

evidence.quote: This process is repeated for each pair of confused concepts.
evidence.support_explanation: 按混淆类对生成概念，append更新。

evidence.quote:
The
γ
\gamma
parameter helps guard against classes that are often misclassified due to failures in the backbone ViT model.
evidence.support_explanation: 重复混淆衰减，不能保证每次改动为正。

evidence.quote: A CBM conditioned on these concepts produces logits for the images in the validation set, and a heuristic identifies classes that are confused for each other.
We follow previous work in using Top-1 accuracy to evaluate the performance of the CBM model on the test set of the classification dataset.
For LM4CV, we replace the concepts learned with library learning with an equal number of concepts sampled from an LLM.
evidence.support_explanation: 同数量概念控制，部分排除库规模解释。

evidence.quote: The overall structure of the original prompt is left unchanged, except for the removal of previous conversations as well as the removal of a line with feedback parsing instructions.
evidence.support_explanation: history消融较明确但同时去掉解析提示。

evidence.quote: We hypothesize these mixed results are induced by poor calibration of LaBO’s CBM’s and as a result of model overfitting on the few available labels for each class.
evidence.support_explanation: fewshot混合/负结果报告而非全部改善。

evidence.quote: we can estimate the total token usage for 50 iterations to be around 128,000 tokens if we only consider just a single query per iteration and around 12.8M tokens for each experiment (approximately an hour).
evidence.support_explanation: 作者估算token成本，非实测全成本。

evidence.quote: and the corresponding evolved library of interpretable concepts
evidence.support_explanation: 留存评价对象包含非权重文本库，即便同时训练adapter仍在范围。

evidence.quote:
Yet, the ablation underperforms LM4CV+
Escher
in all datasets.
evidence.support_explanation: 同时去history与critic的消融，不能完全单独归因critic。

evidence.quote: This motivates the need to keep track of past LLM proposals to each concept set as well as the VLM’s response to each of the changes.
evidence.support_explanation: 历史存储具体proposal及下一轮反馈。

evidence.quote: LM4CV and LM4CV+Escher are trained for the same number of steps per iteration with the same batch size and learning rate.
evidence.support_explanation: 每迭代训练公平，不意味着60轮总计算匹配。

signatures.object: 每类文本概念集合及类对反馈历史H
signatures.information: 类别名、validation图像logits与历史；零样本不需图像标签，监督adapter设置可用训练标签
signatures.operation: fit固定概念下adapter→算类对伪混淆→topK加衰减采样→LLM看历史生成新概念→并集加入→下轮评估写历史
signatures.output: 演化文本概念库与可选adapter
signatures.conditions: VLM能识别细粒度概念且分数校准
signatures.feedback: 无标签混淆/相关性代理；有标签设置可用混淆矩阵
signatures.selection_rule: 混淆加衰减选类对；生成概念直接加入，无accept/reject门槛
signatures.persistence: Ct概念库与H保留下一轮；无退休/版本回滚
signatures.later_use: 下一轮CBM读取，最终test分类读取演化库
signatures.claimed_effect: 分类精度提升和更有效概念
signatures.failure_boundary: few-shot过拟合/校准差，CLIP文本长度截断、跨类碰撞、库和历史增长
